definitions.gloss: standard language; common speech; everyday language
definitions.explanation: The form of a language used in general communication, as opposed to dialect, technical jargon, or literary language. In the Japanese context, refers to the common spoken language as distinct from regional dialects.

examples.japanese: {普通語|ふつうご}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{話|はな}して→話す：00467_hanasu⟧⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。
⟦{方言|ほうげん}→方言：07419_hougen⟧⟦ではなく→ではなく：09578_dehanaku⟧{普通語|ふつうご}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{書|か}かれた→書く：00477_kaku⟧⟦{文章|ぶんしょう}→文章：02957_bunshou⟧だ。
examples.english: This is a text written in standard language, not dialect.

examples.japanese: ⟦{専門|せんもん}{用語|ようご}→専門用語：22120_senmonyougo⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{避|さ}けて→避ける：02109_sakeru⟧{普通語|ふつうご}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{説明|せつめい}する→説明する：05639_setsumeisuru⟧よう⟦{心|こころ}がけている→心がける：10015_kokorogakeru⟧。
examples.english: I try to explain things in everyday language, avoiding technical terms.

notes:
A compound of ⟦{普通|ふつう}→普通：01502_futsuu⟧ (ordinary; common) and ⟦{語|ご}→〜語：09841_go⟧ (language; word). Can refer to either the standard/common form of a language (as opposed to dialects) or to everyday vocabulary (as opposed to jargon). In Chinese linguistics, {普通語|ふつうご} specifically refers to Mandarin Chinese (Putonghua), and this usage also appears in Japanese texts about Chinese language.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {普通語|ふつうご}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{話|はな}す→話す：00467_hanasu⟧: to speak in standard language
- {普通語|ふつうご}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{直|なお}す: to convert to standard language
- {普通語|ふつうご}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{方言|ほうげん}→方言：07419_hougen⟧: standard language and dialect

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{標準語|ひょうじゅんご}→標準語：07421_hyoujungo⟧: standard language — the officially designated national standard, more formal term
- ⟦{共通語|きょうつうご}→共通語：16600_kyoutsuugo⟧: common language — language understood across regions; emphasizes mutual intelligibility
- ⟦{口語|こうご}→口語：12033_kougo⟧: spoken language; colloquial language — contrasts with written or literary language
